name: spindev-docs
description: Documentation skills for spinlockdevelopment Codex CLI: technical-writer scans a repo and emits a delta-aware mkdocs-material design doc ready for GitHub Pages or any static host.

interface.shortDescription: Repo-aware design doc generator with mkdocs output.
interface.longDescription: Documentation skills: the technical-writer scans an entire repository, produces a coherent design doc, and emits mkdocs-formatted Markdown with the mkdocs-material theme — ready for GitHub Pages but portable to any static host. Delta-aware: reruns consult a per-repo state file and either incrementally update only the pages whose source files changed, or full-regen if the delta is too large. Ships an opt-in /docs-deploy command that scaffolds a GitHub Pages workflow.
defaultPrompt: Document this repo as a mkdocs site.
Regenerate the design doc for this project.
Scaffold a GitHub Pages workflow for these docs.
